source_snapshot.items: EC.14_GPU Device Reset: 25x Cold DC Cycles
source_snapshot.procedure: Verify recipe; source requests log clearing; permits PASS inheritance from SY.1; collect results/photos and inspect logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: All GPU PCIe links train to maximum supported generation at x16 with no correctable or uncorrectable errors.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended and 720 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; interprets cold DC as S5 and requires operator-controlled cycles with per-iteration evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; held Pending because graceful S5 with standby rails retained and removal of named DC rails exercise different power boundaries.

old_problem: The title says Cold DC while the same-row AI interpretation says S5. Standard S5 normally retains auxiliary/standby power, whereas removing a named DC rail can reset additional devices and sequencing logic. These are materially different operations and coverage, so parameters cannot choose between them without an owner decision.
disposition_reason: ED-06 and ED-19 explicitly forbid conflating warm, cold, AC and DC mechanisms. The approved source does not identify whether Cold DC means graceful S5 with standby rails retained or controlled removal/restoration of one or more named DC rails. That is core command/coverage semantics with different risks and recovery, not merely a runtime parameter; inventing either would create false coverage.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2146, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2147 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00024-V002 / f6c7124a369d6711 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Owner must select graceful S5 with retained auxiliary rails or removal/restoration of explicitly named DC rail(s); AC loss, warm reboot and device reset remain distinct and cannot substitute.
After selection bind the exact control primitive, observable entry/exit state, affected power domains, dwell/start/boot/OS-ready deadlines and recovery.
Bind all GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF-to-root-port/switch maximum-generation x16 expectations and exactly 25 numbered transitions with complete per-cycle evidence.

Preserve/hash baseline and first-fault evidence instead of clearing logs. Stop on wrong power boundary, shutdown/start/boot timeout, missing GPU, downtraining, new correctable/uncorrectable error or recovery-access loss.
SY.1 may satisfy this row only when it uses the selected identical power boundary and retains all 25 per-cycle artifacts; aggregate PASS is not sufficient.
No S5/DC/AC/reboot action, GPU/link query, log clearing, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Power-domain-explicit 25-cycle Cold DC or S5 GPU PCIe recovery qualification
test_case.purpose: After the owner selects the exact Cold DC/S5 power boundary, prove every expected GPU re-enumerates and every PCIe link trains to its approved maximum generation at x16 with zero new correctable or uncorrectable errors after each of 25 transitions.
required_package: Owner decision selecting graceful S5 with retained rails or exact named DC-rail removal/restoration
Approved NVIDIA GPU/PCIe inventory, link and AER collection toolchain
Signed GPU/root-port/switch maximum-generation x16 topology matrix
Signed control/state proof, affected power-domain, dwell/start/boot/OS-ready timing and 25-cycle ledger
Dedicated drained SUT, authorized operator, BMC/console, SY.1 artifact map and mode-specific recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending the engineering decision selecting S5 or exact named-DC-rail semantics. Preserve/hash baseline evidence. After selection and point approval, perform exactly 25 supervised transitions using only that primitive, proving the selected entry/exit state and readiness. Before the next transition record complete GPU inventory, link capability/current generation/x16, AER, NVIDIA/OS/BMC/power/thermal state. Stop on first deviation; do not substitute AC/warm/reset, clear logs or retry.
test_case.expected_result: For the selected power boundary, all 25 numbered transitions prove correct state entry/exit and reach BMC/OS-ready by deadline; every expected GPU returns at stable identity, all links train to signed maximum generation x16, and zero disqualifying correctable/uncorrectable errors or abnormal power/thermal events occur.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until S5 versus named-DC semantics and the mode-specific control/oracle are approved. PASS requires all 25 complete accepted ledgers for exactly that boundary. FAIL on wrong/ambiguous state, timing failure, missing GPU, downtraining, new disqualifying error, abnormal health or failed recovery. Missing decision/input/artifact is BLOCKED; AC/warm/reset or aggregate SY.1 evidence cannot substitute.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until the owner selects S5 or exact named DC rail(s) and signs state proof, blast radius, timing and recovery.
Use a dedicated drained SUT, verify the intended power domain before every transition and retain console/BMC recovery.
Preserve baseline and first-fault evidence; every transition requires authorized operator oversight.
Stop without another transition or automatic retry on first mismatch or fault.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved S5-or-DC decision, control identity, authorization and SY.1 traceability
Selected power-domain/state definition plus GPU/root-port/switch maximum-generation x16 matrix
Twenty-five numbered operator records proving entry, dwell, start, boot and readiness for the selected boundary
Per cycle: complete GPU inventory, PCIe capabilities/LnkSta/AER, NVIDIA, kernel/journal, BMC/SEL, power/thermal/health artifacts
First-fault/mode-specific recovery or stable state after cycle 25, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong/ambiguous power state, unexpected rail effect, timeout, missing GPU, downtraining, AER, abnormal health or lost recovery access, inhibit further transitions and preserve the first failed state. Do not switch to a different power mechanism or retry automatically; follow the selected mode-specific recovery and quarantine if topology/health is not restored.

source_conflict.reason: The source title and Criteria are internally consistent at a high level; Cold DC versus S5 is an unresolved operation semantic rather than two separately authoritative conflicting sources.

blocked.reason: Static review can precisely record the unresolved power decision and safe gates. Execution is blocked, but the review record itself is not globally classified BLOCKED.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Owner decision selecting graceful S5 or exact named DC rail(s), then the mode-specific control/state proof, blast radius, timing, topology/max-link oracle, 25-cycle ledger, SY.1 mapping and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION PENDING; COLD-DC/S5 MODE GATE CLOSED; NO S5/DC/AC/REBOOT ACTION, GPU/LINK QUERY, LOG CLEAR, RECOVERY, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: Platform power/firmware, HGX/NVIDIA qualification, PCIe topology and safety/recovery owners
pending.unlock_condition: Approve one exact power boundary and its mode-specific control and recovery. Runtime parameters alone cannot decide which state transition is the required coverage.

external_authorities.application: Forbids conflating AC, DC, cold, warm and reset mechanisms and requires exact OFF/state-to-ON-to-ready evidence, preserved logs, recovery and no retry.

project_authority: Platform power owner selects and defines S5 or named DC-rail semantics; HGX/PCIe owner supplies topology/max-link/SY.1 oracle; authorized operator owns transitions and recovery; engineer owns verdict.
